data.title: Donald Trump threatens Iranian nuclear site Pickaxe Mountain with US air strikes | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Trump did not confirm previous reports that the US would use a GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast bomb (MOAB), colloquially known as the "mother of all bombs," to strike Iran.
data.keywords: Iran,United States,iran and us,Donald Trump,Natanz,Operation Epic Fury,Pickaxe Mountain
